source: Terminal use by alliance as published by the airports and in news coverage; stand-name prefixes from the OpenStreetMap layouts in germany.ground.json, matched to the piers by position. FRA: Lufthansa and Star Alliance in Terminal 1 (piers A, B, C); the other airlines moved from Terminal 2 to the new Terminal 3 (piers G, H, J) in April-June 2026 in waves whose per-pier split is not published, so Terminals 2 and 3 form one area (Fraport; travelmole.com and aerotelegraph.de on the T3 opening, April 2026); Condor stays in Terminal 1 until its move to Terminal 3 in summer 2027 (touristik-aktuell.de); cargo carriers on the CargoCity aprons (stands F and the numbered CargoCity Sued stands). MUC: Lufthansa and Star Alliance in Terminal 2 and its satellite (stands 2xx and 3xx), the other airlines in Terminal 1 (stands 1xx); Eurowings is listed in Terminal 1 by most sources (Munich Airport, Wikipedia). Remote stands (FRA V, W; MUC 5xx, 6xx, 9xx) serve everyone.
